adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the mutation persists new attendees to the DB first via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) and only afterwards calls eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking) with no try/catch or transaction rollback. If updateCalendarAttendees throws, the mutation errors while the DB changes remain. On a retry, booking is re-fetched including the newly-created attendees, so uniqueGuests becomes empty (filtered out by `booking.attendees.some(...)`) and the handler throws BAD_REQUEST (`emails_must_be_unique_valid`), leaving no recovery path in this flow to remove the partially-added attendees.
